results.title: Maqbool
results.overview: The Scottish tragedy 'Macbeth' set in the contemporary underworld of India's commercial capital; two corrupt, fortune telling policemen take the roles of the weird sisters, and "Duncan" is Abbaji, the head of a crime family.

results.title: Hate Story 2
results.overview: A young photographer from Mumbai uses her mind to play games with a prominent Hindu rightist leader.

results.title: Wazir
results.overview: 'Wazir' is a tale of two unlikely friends, a wheelchair-bound chess grandmaster and a brave ATS officer. Brought together by grief and a strange twist of fate, the two men decide to help each other win the biggest games of their lives. But there's a mysterious, dangerous opponent lurking in the shadows, who is all set to checkmate them.

results.title: Thackeray
results.overview: Based on the life of Keshav Thackeray, an Indian politician who is also known as Balasaheb Thackeray.

results.title: Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa
results.overview: A man belongs to a middle-class family and is intent on pursuing his career with a music group, despite his dad's disapproval. He is also in love with the lead singer, but she sees him mainly as a friend.

results.title: Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar
results.overview: Sanjay, a carefree young man, experiences mental and physical transformation to compete in an inter-collegiate bicycle race after his elder brother is unable to participate due to an injury.

results.title: Heropanti
results.overview: Two young people find love despite the violent landscape in which they live.

results.title: Bhoothnath
results.overview: Moving into a new house, a family witnesses an unfriendly ghost who wants to drive them away from the house. However, he befriends a little boy who changes his outlook forever.

results.title: Stolen
results.overview: The five-month-old baby of impoverished tribal woman Jhumpa Mahato is stolen. Two brothers, Gautam and Raman, who witness the kidnapping, try to help her and become embroiled in the complexities of the investigation.

results.title: Mission Kashmir
results.overview: A police officer adopts the son and sole survivor of a family he has massacred while pursuing a terrorist. After some time the foster son finds out what the stepfather did.

results.title: Go Goa Gone
results.overview: A rave party off the coast of Goa goes horrifyingly and hilariously wrong when the island is overrun with zombies.

results.title: Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran
results.overview: A look at India's second confidential nuclear test series at Pokhran lead by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, during the time of PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee's tenure.

results.title: Khel Khel Mein
results.overview: What if for one night your mobile phone was a public property? 7 friends at a wedding after-party decide to play a seemingly harmless but as it turns out, a dangerous game which might have earth-shattering consequences with relationships, marriages and identities being at stake.

results.title: Dulhan Hum Le Jayenge
results.overview: Sapna is raised by her three uncles, each one of them with a contrasting pursuit in life. She falls in love with Raja, who tries to impress each of her uncles in a different manner.

results.title: Photograph
results.overview: A struggling street photographer, pressured to marry by his grandmother, convinces a shy stranger to pose as his fiancée. The pair develops a connection that transforms them in ways that they could not expect.

results.title: Dhokha: Round D Corner
results.overview: When a delusional housewife with a personality disorder is taken hostage by a terrorist on the loose and a husband accused of cheating on his wife have their own versions of reality, how do we know who's saying the truth?

results.title: Ki & Ka
results.overview: An unconventional woman, gains immense success in her professional life but things take a turn when she meets a guy, who wants to be a house husband.

results.title: Dhamaal
results.overview: Four friends meet an underworld don who, on his deathbed, clues them in on hidden treasure buried in Goa. The group race towards Goa, not knowing that their plans will soon be foiled, albeit hilariously, by a police officer, who is also after the money.

results.title: Kaabil
results.overview: Rohan is a kind, happy young man who has been blind since birth and works as a voice-over artist for a living. Through friends, he meets Supriya, a working woman who is also blind, but proudly independent. The two start liking each other and get married. Rohan toughest journey starts in his quest of vengeance for Supriya's indirect murderers.

results.title: Bala
results.overview: A man suffering from alopecia copes with his lack of self-confidence and the societal pressure that comes with being bald.
